scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix apps/worker run dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/worker install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix apps/worker run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.build:personal: npm --prefix apps/worker run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build:personal
scripts.verify:personal: npm run docs:i18n:check && npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm run test:all && npm run build:personal
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix apps/worker test && npm --prefix apps/web test
